From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@wildgrove.com>

Date: 2028-04-09T08:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor registration + PO activation for Wildgrove — initial packet

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Wildgrove is ready to add Redwood as an approved vendor in our AP portal. Attached is a sample CSV of how our portal expects vendor fields (wildgrove_portal_sample.csv). A couple of must-haves before we can activate PO issuance: 
- VAT registration or EU VAT self-cert for the billing entity
- Legal company name + VAT ID must match the invoice header
- Bank details for ACH/SEPA with IBAN and SWIFT/BIC for EUR payments
- PO header must include the 6-digit Project Code (we use that to route invoices)

Our AP team prefers PDF invoices with a PO reference in filename: PO{po-number}_Redwood_invoice.pdf. We will run a test invoice once vendor is active.

Can you confirm Redwood can upload the vendor packet and VAT evidence this week? If you have any required Vendor ID fields we don’t accept by CSV, let me know and I’ll open a portal exception.

Attaching: wildgrove_portal_sample.csv

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager — Wildgrove Labs

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear checklist and the CSV sample. We can get the packet uploaded this week. Quick notes / asks from our side: 

1) We have two legal entities that might be used on invoices (Redwood Inference, Inc. and Redwood Inference EU Ltd). Which billing entity should appear on the PO/invoice? Please confirm the exact legal name and VAT ID you want on record — we will match it exactly.

2) Bank attestation: our finance team prefers to provide a bank attestation via DocuSign rather than embedding details in a CSV. Would that be acceptable for SEPA setup? If yes, we’ll send a DocuSign envelope to ops@wildgrove.com.

3) Project Code mapping: can you confirm whether Project Code is required on the invoice body only, or must it be present in the filename as well? Our billing system can add Project Code to the header easily but filename changes require manual intervene for a small number of pilot invoices.

I’ve attached our standard vendor onboarding packet which includes W-8/W-9 equivalents, VAT self-cert template, and bank attestation form. We’ll plan to upload the packet to your portal after we get the legal-entity confirmation.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm legal name + VAT ID to use (reply)
- We send DocuSign bank attestation to your AP contact (if acceptable)
- Redwood uploads vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf to portal and notifies you

Best,

Date: 2028-04-10T09:34:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Vendor registration + PO activation for Wildgrove — mapping question

Looping in for visibility — two quick pieces: 

- GL / cost-center mapping: Wildgrove’s Project Code will need to map to our internal product GL. If the Project Code is only on the filename, it will break automated mapping. Strong preference: Project Code must be a distinct invoice field (header or line-level).

- Payment SLA: Wildgrove’s portal notes standard Net45. For the pilot integration (first two invoices) I’d recommend we request Net30 with early-payment discount language disabled to reduce reconciliation risk. Marissa, can Finance approve a temporary Net30 exception if vendor activation could speed up collections?

Forwarding Soojin’s reply below.

Thanks Ben / Soojin — answers below.

1) Billing entity: please register "Redwood Inference EU Ltd" with VAT GB999888777 (use exactly that name and ID).

2) Project Code: required as invoice header field (not filename). Our portal ingests the header field to route invoices automatically. Please ensure field "project_code" is populated in your upload and in the PDF header.

3) Bank attestation via DocuSign is fine. Please send envelope to ops@aureliapay.com and cc ops@wildgrove.com. For SEPA we need a signed attestation and proof of account (bank statement stub masked).

4) VAT evidence: we accept EU VAT registration certificate or the EU VAT self-cert form in the packet. If you have a VAT-exempt situation, attach the supporting documentation.

We created a portal invite for Redwood: https://vendor.wildgrove.com/signup/portal/INVITE-2039 (expires in 7 days). Once you sign up, you can upload vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf and the attestation. After upload we’ll run a quick validation and schedule a test PO (we aim for April 17th).

Attaching: vendor_portal_integration_notes.pdf (short checklist)

Best,
